We need DBE from molecular formula C8H10N2O3. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). O ignored. So compute: C=8, H=10, N=2.

DBE = 8 - 10/2 + 2/2 + 1 = 8 -5 +1 +1 = 5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Could verify using tool. Use retrieve_dbe_formula.
